$comment: AgentGate policy file. Evaluation order for every tools/call:
1. IDENTITY  - the token the gateway was launched with (env AGENTGATE_TOKEN)
must match one agent below, or the gateway refuses to start.
2. ALLOWLIST - the tool must match the agent's allowedTools globs,
otherwise the call is DENIED (and the tool is hidden from tools/list).
3. RULES     - first matching rule wins. A rule matches on tool glob and,
optionally, on argument glob patterns. No rule matches -> defaultEffect.
4. SCREENING - upstream results are scanned before they reach the agent.
Tokens: 'token' is a literal (demo only). Prefer 'tokenEnv': the name of an
environment variable holding the token, so secrets stay out of the file.

agents.description: Full demo identity: reads allowed, terminate_instance needs approval.
agents.name: demo-agent

agents.description: Read-only identity: destructive tools are not even allowlisted.
agents.name: readonly-agent

rules.reason: Destructive action: terminating an instance requires a human decision.
Production instance termination always requires approval (argument-pattern rule).
